name: Electricity supplied from grid - supplier mix
source_dataset: Climate declaration for physically delivered electricity
description: Emission intensity of total electricity consumption (physically delivered grid-average mix) in Norway. Calculated and reported by the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE). This emission factor accounts for greenhouse gas emissions from electricity consumed in Norway including both domestically produced and imported electricity with trade adjustments reflecting exchanges with the European power system.
